title: Secret Meeting
paragraphs: “That pig… excuse me. He may not be a king, but tonight is going to be a long one,” Itsuki muttered, looking completely exhausted.

Indeed. First, the incident with Takt during the day. Then, the audience with the Pig King in the evening, followed by Takt’s eradication at night. And now, they were on their way to meet the Queen. It was certainly a busy schedule.
“Yeah. This is going to be troublesome.”
“Indeed.”
“I’d say a significant portion of the cause is you, Motoyasu-kun.”
Father said that to me. How outrageous. I am earnestly fighting to save the world. As we chatted, we walked through the labyrinth-like halls of Faubrey’s castle.
“So, Eclair-san. Did something happen when you met with the Queen? Like, she wouldn’t listen to you or something?”
“No, the Queen is a wise woman. It’s not that she wouldn’t listen to me. Rather, she explained to me the troublesome issues occurring in Melromarc.”
“Hmm… what kind of issues?”
“I’d prefer you hear it directly from the Queen herself.”
“I’d rather not meet her if possible. After all, because of our involvement, her husband and daughter were killed.”
“I’m not here to place blame, but those who tried to kill us just because things didn’t go their way have no righteousness on their side.”

“…Even though the Queen may have her own feelings about the matter, she made it clear to me that she does not intend to condemn you, Heroes. Had the circumstances been different, there was a possibility we could have been enemies, but she is not acting based on personal emotions.”

Éclair explained this to Father and the others with a very serious expression. Meanwhile, I was walking, worried whether the castle of Faubrey smelled like a pigsty. After all, the king was a pig. The castle was illuminated by magic, but it still felt dim. We were led to what seemed to be another guest room. Éclair lightly knocked on the door.
“This is Eclair Seaetto. I have brought the Heroes.”
“You may enter.”
“Excuse us.”

Éclair opened the door and guided us inside. The interior was nearly identical to the guest rooms assigned to us. The Queen was seated on a chair at the back of the room. Behind her, there was a sizable stack of documents. Diplomatic efforts, perhaps?
“Queen… Eclair Seaetto, reporting back.”
Éclair bowed deeply as she spoke.
“I have also brought the Four Holy Heroes.”
“Lady Seaetto, I am truly grateful for your compliance with this directive.”
“Yes! It is an honor!”
Her gentle demeanor seemed to catch Father and the others off guard. The Queen turned her gaze toward us, placed a hand lightly over her chest, and then opened her mouth to speak.
“The Queen of Melromarc… I am Mirellia Q. Melromarc. As the representative of this nation, I extend my deepest apologies to you, Heroes, for the atrocities committed by my husband and daughter.”
With those words, the Queen bowed deeply before us.
“Uh, um… okay.”
Father and the others responded awkwardly, unsure of how to react. How unnecessarily roundabout. What exactly are they hesitating for?
“The Love Hunter! I am Motoyasu Kitamura!”
“Motoyasu-san, you’re jumping the gun with the introductions!”
“How can you introduce yourself so shamelessly?!”
For some reason, Ren and Itsuki reprimanded me. Meanwhile, the Queen smiled gently, seemingly unfazed.
“W-Well… let’s just go ahead with the introductions. I am Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero.”
“…As much as I hate to admit it, thanks to Motoyasu-san’s lack of hesitation, we’re able to speak now as well. I am Itsuki Kawasumi, the Bow Hero.”
“It’s a difficult situation to navigate, given our history… but I am Ren Amaki, the Sword Hero.”
Following my lead, Father and the others introduced themselves. Now, we could move on with the conversation more quickly.
“So… what is it that you wanted to discuss with us?”
“Yes. I will speak to you while incorporating what I have heard from Lady Seaetto regarding the Heroes’ experiences.”
The Queen shifted from her previous gentle smile to a serious expression as she began explaining to Father and the others.
“I have heard that you Heroes suppressed the second Wave in Melromarc and also investigated the nation’s internal affairs.”
“Yes, we worked with Eclair-san to examine the issues within the country and the lack of awareness regarding the Waves.”

Itsuki agreed with the Queen’s statement. It was truly an appalling situation. If this sort of thing had been happening in every world, the thought alone sent shivers down my spine. …Although, this was the first time I had encountered people as strange as those we met.
“What were your honest impressions of our country? I would like to hear your thoughts as Heroes.”
“Honest impressions, huh…”
Itsuki looked at us, struggling to come up with a response. There was no need to hold back, was there?

“First off, the upper echelons are completely rotten. The whole anti-demi-human ideology is absurd. Because of it, Naofumi was subjected to severe discrimination, and we were nearly manipulated into being complicit.”
“Y-Yeah. If not for Motoyasu-san, we probably… would have been trapped in our own rigid preconceptions, making fools of ourselves.”
Father remained silent. What’s the matter with him?
“That is indeed a painful truth to hear. I had been doing my best to suppress discrimination within the country. However…”
“If I remember correctly, Eclair-san’s father, who was advocating for better treatment of demi-humans after the Waves, was killed. That led to an increase in demi-human hunting, right?”

“Yes. It is truly lamentable… My husband also rose to prominence through his wars against the demi-humans… and yet, when he should have been promoting reconciliation, he made foolish decisions. In the end, he conspired with the Three Heroes Church to summon the Four Holy Heroes, then, along with my daughter, attempted to trap the Shield Hero. According to reports, you Heroes saw through the conspiracy, rejected it, and he even tried to have you killed.”

As the Queen muttered those words, an oppressive atmosphere filled the air. She was venting her frustrations about Trash. In the first world, she had punished Trash with her personal feelings involved. It seems that resentment has carried over into this world as well.
“For the actions of my husband and daughter, I sincerely apologize. There are no words to excuse their wrongdoings…”
“Ah, well… this isn’t something that can be resolved just with an apology, but… I’m sorry as well,” Father spoke up and apologized.
There was no need for him to apologize. Or so I thought, but Ren and Itsuki also looked rather uncomfortable.
“After that, we traveled from Siltvelt, honing our skills while observing the state of the world… Eventually, we decided to return to investigate Melromarc.”
“To be precise, it was because of the problems that Motoyasu-san recalled.”
“That’s right. Queen, you’ve heard from Eclair-san that Motoyasu-kun came from the future, haven’t you?”
Well, it’s something I’ve talked about in various places. Whether people believe it or not is another matter, but anyone with a sharp ear should at least be aware of the information.

“Yes, I have heard. In addition, several inexplicable and suspicious events in Melromarc have been reported by my spies, and what happened here in Faubrey just a few hours ago… When I piece it all together, it does seem like knowledge that could only come from someone who knows the future.”
“Y-You believe me?”
“Yes. The Four Holy Heroes are beings akin to gods in this world. It would not be strange for them to possess such mysterious powers.”
As expected, the Queen has remarkable insight. It seems safe to assume she does not make poor judgments.
“And… there was also the matter earlier today.”
“Earlier today?”
“Come out now. How long do you intend to keep hiding?”
The Queen called out toward the bed, and from underneath it, Fiancée emerged.
“Huh? You’re…”
Fiancée averted her gaze from Father as she walked toward us hesitantly.
“This is my daughter, Melty. She met with you Heroes earlier today… Thank you for saving her.”
“Ah, uh… yeah…”
Father, realizing Fiancée’s identity, turned to glare at me. Then, in a hushed voice, he asked,
“Fiancée… is the princess of Melromarc?!”
“That’s right.”
“That’s right?! Do you not realize how serious this is? We were acting so casually with her, even though we’re technically the ones responsible for her father’s fate!”
Oh? Father is scolding me.
But no matter what happens to Trash, does it really change my relationship with Fiancée? To be honest, it seemed to me that she always found Trash to be a nuisance.
“Is there a problem with that?”
